meta.transportLine: All travel by hotel shuttle / bus / MTR / ferry / cable car
meta.overview: Every day starts and ends at Regala Skycity Hotel in the SKYCITY zone, linked to Terminal 2 and AsiaWorld-Expo by covered walkways. The hotel runs free shuttles to the airport (T1), Tung Chung Station and Disneyland; when the shuttle isn't running, take bus S1/S56 to Tung Chung

days.title: Arrive in Hong Kong and rest
days.summary: Land, check in, have dinner at the airport, get your Octopus and Disney ticket ready, early night

items.title: Land at HKG
items.detail: Clear immigration and collect bags; allow 45–60 minutes

items.title: Buy or top up an Octopus at the MTR counter in the arrivals hall
items.detail: Do it before leaving the airport — you'll need it for the bus tomorrow morning

items.title: Free hotel shuttle → check in at Regala Skycity Hotel
items.detail: Follow the Hotel Coach signs at T1 · departures every 15–40 minutes, first come, first served

items.title: Dinner
items.detail: Restaurants in SKYCITY / Terminal 2 within walking distance of the hotel, or eat in T1 before boarding the shuttle — better value than the hotel restaurants

items.title: Prepare for tomorrow
items.detail: Ask the concierge about the Disney shuttle: morning departure times, whether it's free, and return times tomorrow night · Open the Hong Kong Disneyland app to confirm your park date is registered and check opening hours

items.title: Early night
items.detail: Set an alarm for 07:00 — leave at 08:15 tomorrow

notes: No rush — if the flight is 1–2 hours late, just have dinner later. The T1 shuttle runs until about 23:45
Hotel breakfast is usually pricey; if it isn't included, pick up bread/milk at an airport convenience store tonight

days.title: Hong Kong Disneyland
days.summary: Leave the hotel at 08:15, reach the gates before 09:30, stay through the night show, then take the hotel shuttle back

items.title: Breakfast
items.detail: Eat well before the park — food inside is expensive

items.title: Leave hotel → bus S56 or S1 from the SKYCITY / AsiaWorld-Expo stop to Tung Chung Station
items.detail: The first hotel shuttle to Tung Chung at 09:05 is too late today · If the concierge confirms a direct Disney shuttle before 09:00, take that instead (~15–20 min)

items.title: MTR Tung Chung Line → Sunny Bay → Disneyland Resort Line
items.detail: At Sunny Bay, cross the platform to the Disney train

items.title: At the park gates — over 1 hour before opening
items.detail: If the park opens at 10:00 that day, shift everything 30 minutes earlier (leave the hotel at 07:45)

items.title: Park opens → head straight to World of Frozen
items.detail: It has the longest queues; opening time is your best chance

items.title: Mystic Manor and Big Grizzly Mountain
Lunch
items.detail: Eat after the noon peak when restaurants are quieter

items.title: Toy Story Land, Iron Man Experience, Fantasyland
items.detail: Check the afternoon parade time in the app's Times Guide and grab a spot 15–20 minutes early

items.title: Christmas-themed photo walk + dinner
Night show at the castle
items.detail: Check the show time in the app in the morning

items.title: Hotel shuttle back (skip the MTR crush)
items.detail: Board at Coach Park — Good Neighbour Hotel Shuttle Station · departs about 50 minutes after the show starts, stops at Regal Airport Hotel first, then Regala Skycity · limited seats, first come, first served (reconfirm times with the hotel)
items.warn: If you miss it: MTR → Tung Chung → bus S1/S56 · ~60 min · ~HK$20

days.title: Hong Kong Island + Kowloon
days.summary: Victoria Peak, dim sum in Central, Tai Kwun, Star Ferry, TST waterfront, Symphony of Lights, Temple Street, photo booth

items.title: Leave hotel → bus S56/S1 → Tung Chung → MTR to Hong Kong Station

leg.text: Bus ~15 min + MTR ~30 min + walk · total ~1 hr · ~HK$29

items.title: Bus 15 up to Victoria Peak
items.detail: Board at Central (Exchange Square) terminus; sit upstairs on the left for great views on the way up — far cheaper than the Peak Tram

items.title: Victoria Peak
items.detail: Free viewpoints: Lion's Pavilion and the Peak Circle Walk (flat, ~1 hr) — no need to pay for the Sky Terrace

items.title: Bus 15 back down to Central
Dim sum in Central
Mid-Levels Escalator → Tai Kwun
items.detail: Tai Kwun is free, with seating and restrooms (PMQ dropped to avoid too much walking after Disney day — stop by if you still have energy)

items.title: Walk down to Central Pier 7 → Star Ferry across to TST
TST waterfront, Avenue of Stars, K11 Musea
items.detail: Sunset gives the best view of Hong Kong Island — find a spot to rest your legs before the show

items.title: Harbour stroll + photo booth
items.detail: SNAPIO kiosks inside K11 MUSEA (B2/F near BRUNO, 3/F near Five Guys), right by Avenue of Stars — about HK$60 per set, Octopus accepted; back on the promenade in time for the 20:00 show · for a Korean studio with rooms and props, go to FLASH at K11 Art Mall (8–10 min walk) around 18:00–19:15 instead

items.title: Symphony of Lights
items.detail: Watch from the TST waterfront (reconfirm the show time before going)

items.title: Temple Street Night Market + street-food dinner

leg.text: MTR TST → Jordan, 1 stop, or walk ~15 min

items.title: Back to hotel: Jordan → Lai King (change) → Tung Chung → bus S1/S56
items.detail: Arrive at the hotel around 23:00 · the last hotel shuttle from Tung Chung is 21:15, so take the bus

days.title: Lantau, then fly home
days.summary: Free shuttle to Tung Chung, cable car to the Big Buddha, shop at Citygate, then collect bags and check in by 18:00

items.title: Breakfast, check out, leave bags at the hotel
Free hotel shuttle → Tung Chung Station, then walk to the cable car terminal
items.detail: First run of the day, first come, first served; if full, take bus S1/S56 instead

items.title: Queue for the Ngong Ping 360 cable car (Standard Cabin)
items.detail: Saturdays are busy — book online in advance and make sure it isn't a maintenance closure day

leg.text: Cable car ~25 min + queue · HK$295 round trip

items.title: Tian Tan Buddha and Po Lin Monastery
items.detail: About 268 steps up to the Buddha — take it slowly, no rush

items.title: Lunch: vegetarian meal at the monastery or a restaurant in Ngong Ping Village
Queue for the cable car down to Tung Chung
items.detail: Saturday afternoon queues down are long, so don't leave it later than this · Backup if the cable car is closed: bus 23 (HK$20.4)
items.warn: Time-critical point · allow 30–60 min for the queue

items.title: Citygate Outlets
items.detail: Right next to Tung Chung Station — shop for souvenirs; affordable food court

items.title: Back to the hotel to collect bags
items.detail: Hotel shuttle from Tung Chung (hourly, check times at the stop) or bus S1/S56 if the timing doesn't work

items.title: Free hotel shuttle → airport
items.detail: If your airline uses T2, just walk over via the covered walkway

items.title: Airport check-in
items.detail: Arrive 3 hours before departure · check in advance which terminal your airline uses

items.title: Fly back to Bangkok · arrive around 23:15

paceCheck.text: The only connection is the hotel shuttle from T1, which runs late, so even a delayed flight won't affect the next day

From SKYCITY the bus goes to Tung Chung without looping around the airport. Leave 08:15, reach the gates around 09:15 with 15 minutes to spare, and return on the hotel shuttle — no MTR crush after the show

The toughest day: it follows Disney day and the MTR ride back takes about 1 hr. So departure moved to 08:00, PMQ was dropped, rest stops added at Tai Kwun and the TST waterfront, and Temple Street ends by 21:45

The 09:05 free shuttle to Tung Chung fits the cable car timing nicely. The trip's only risk is the Saturday queue down from the cable car, so queuing starts at 13:30, leaving about 3.5 hours before the 18:00 check-in. If the queue runs long, cut the Citygate shopping time

rows.item: Transport for the whole trip (bus, MTR, bus 15, Star Ferry · hotel shuttle free)
Ngong Ping 360 cable car (Standard, round trip)

budget.excluded: Excludes: flights, hotel, Disney ticket (1-day ticket price depends on the date, about HK$669–939; after buying, register your park date on the official website) · Exchange rates fluctuate — check again before exchanging

book: Buy a Disney ticket for Thu 26 Nov, then register the park date on the official website
Check park opening hours for the 26th on the park calendar (if it opens at 10:00, leave the hotel at 07:45)
Book Ngong Ping 360 cable car tickets for Sat 28 Nov and check for maintenance closures
Check which terminal your return airline uses
Ask Regala Skycity about the Disney shuttle: morning runs, return runs, free for all guests?, booking required?
Get the latest airport and Tung Chung shuttle timetable and ask about luggage storage after check-out
Check Symphony of Lights show times
pack: Octopus card (load HK$150–200; works on buses, MTR and ferries)
Light jacket — late-November mornings and evenings are cool, and it's windy on the Peak and up the mountain
Your most comfortable walking shoes — lots of walking on days 2 and 3
Power bank (the Disney app drains your battery all day)
Motion-sickness pills (in case you take bus 23 up the mountain)

routes.text: Free shuttle to Tung Chung (09:05–21:15, hourly) or bus S56/S1 → Tung Chung Station → connect to MTR

routes.label: To Disney
routes.text: Tung Chung Line → Sunny Bay → Disneyland Resort Line (MTR HK$15.9) or the hotel shuttle if a run fits your timing

updates.title: Symphony of Lights may end before 27 Nov
updates.text: The 2026–27 government budget announced the show will be retired in the second half of 2026 and replaced by rotating light festivals. No final date has been announced (a 21 Sep 2026 notice says it still runs as usual) — check again the week before you travel. If it's cancelled, the TST waterfront night view is still beautiful

updates.title: Return check-in may be at Terminal 2
updates.text: Since 27 May 2026, T2 has opened for departure check-in only; passengers then take the train to board at T1. Airlines already moved include Hong Kong Airlines, HK Express, AirAsia, Batik Air, VietJet and Cebu Pacific — if yours is one, walk from the hotel to T2 via the covered walkway as the plan says

updates.title: Latest hotel ↔ Tung Chung shuttle timetable differs slightly from the plan
updates.text: Official timetable (27 Apr 2026 edition): from the hotel, first run 08:05, then 09:05, 10:05 … last run 22:05 · From Tung Chung Exit A, first run 08:15, last run 22:15 (the plan said 09:05–21:15) · So on day 2 the 08:05 run can replace the 08:15 bus · On day 3, leaving Jordan at 21:45 reaches Tung Chung around 22:25, missing the 22:15 run, so take bus S1/S56 as planned · The shuttle is for hotel guests only; show your key card

updates.title: Airport shuttle runs later than the plan says
updates.text: Shuttles from the Airport Coach Station to the hotel run every 30 minutes until 01:30 (the plan said about 23:45). Board at Hotel Coach Station Bay 9–11 — if you can't find it, ask at the Regal Hotels counter B15 in the T1 arrivals hall

updates.title: Disney shuttle: outbound too late for the plan, return works as planned
updates.text: Outbound runs only at 09:15 (arriving 09:45) and 10:15 — later than the plan's target gate arrival (09:15), so stick with bus + MTR as planned · The return leaves Coach Park – Good Neighbour Hotel Shuttle Station Row 2 about 50 minutes after the Momentous show starts (valid until 31 Dec 2026), stops at Regal Airport Hotel first, then Regala. There's no backup run if you miss it

updates.title: Park hours for the 26th not yet announced · coincides with Christmas season
updates.text: Typical weekday hours are 10:30–20:00, matching the plan (park opens 10:30), but check the Park Calendar again · 1-day adult ticket Tier 1–4 = HK$669 / 759 / 849 / 939 · 'A Disney Christmas' runs 20 Nov 2026 – 3 Jan 2027: World of Frozen decorations with artificial snow, a new castle show and a Christmas tree lighting ceremony · Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel closed for renovation from 12 Oct 2026 (doesn't affect this plan)

updates.title: Cable car opens 09:00 on Saturdays · no November maintenance closure announced
updates.text: Open 09:00–18:30 on weekends, so the 09:30 queue in the plan fits · Standard round trip HK$295, matching the plan · The latest maintenance closure was 8–18 Sep 2026; no November closure announced yet (as of 18 Oct), but service can be suspended during storms

updates.title: Bus 23 on Saturday still charges the weekday fare of HK$20.4
updates.text: The HK$37 holiday fare applies only on Sundays/public holidays, and there are no Hong Kong public holidays during 25–28 Nov 2026

updates.title: Actual 2026 fares
updates.text: No MTR fare increase in 2026: Tung Chung→Disneyland HK$15.9, Tung Chung→Hong Kong HK$24.3, Jordan→Tung Chung HK$18.7 · Bus S1/S56 HK$3.7 · Citybus 15 HK$13.0 · Star Ferry upper deck on Friday HK$5.0 · Pending bus and ferry fare increase applications may take effect before the trip

updates.title: Mid-Levels Escalator runs uphill after 10:00
updates.text: 06:00–10:00 runs downhill, 10:00–24:00 runs uphill — the plan uses it at 13:45, so going up is easy

practical.title: Late-November weather
practical.text: November normals (Hong Kong Observatory 1991–2020): mean max 24.5°C, mean min 20.3°C, rainfall 39.3 mm on about 5.7 days, humidity 72% · Late month is usually cooler than average, expect about 18–24°C, nights may drop to 15–17°C · The Peak and Ngong Ping are 2–4°C cooler and windier than the city

practical.title: Exchange rate
practical.text: 1 HKD ≈ 4.26 THB (mid-market, 18 Oct 2026); the plan used 4.3, which is close · Money changers typically differ from mid-market by about 1–3%

practical.title: Octopus
practical.text: On-Loan Octopus: HK$50 deposit + HK$150 stored value, sold at MTR Customer Service Centres (including Airport Station) · Tourist Octopus HK$39, no deposit · iPhone users can add a card to Apple Wallet and top up by credit card

hkg-airport.intro: The trip's gateway: you land at Terminal 1, and it is also where you check in for the flight home. The terminal connects to the Airport Express station and the hotel shuttle pick-up points.
hkg-airport.address: 1 Sky Plaza Road, Chek Lap Kok, Lantau Island

facts.label: Hours
facts.value: Open 24 hours; Arrivals (Arrivals Hall A/B) is on Level 5 of T1

facts.label: Getting there
facts.value: To Regala Skycity: the hotel's free shuttle (see regala-skycity) or bus S1/S56 (HK$3.7) from the Terminal 1 (North/South) stops on Cheong Tat Road; to the city: Airport Express or an A-route bus

facts.label: Time needed
facts.value: 30–60 minutes after landing (immigration + baggage claim + buying an Octopus card)

highlights: The MTR Customer Service Centre is at the Airport Express Airport Station, which connects to the T1 arrivals hall — you can buy or return an On-Loan Octopus there
Regal Hotels International Airport Counter B15 is in the T1 arrivals hall (per the map in Regala's shuttle PDF)

T2: only the check-in/departures (landside) area is open, since 27 May 2026 — passengers check in at T2 and take the APM train to board at T1. Hong Kong Airlines moved first, followed by ~14 more airlines (e.g. HK Express, AirAsia from 28 May, Batik Air, Hainan, IndiGo, VietJet, Cebu Pacific); the move finished on 10 June 2026
All arrivals are still at T1 — T2 arrivals are scheduled to open within 2027
tips: For the flight home (28 Nov), check your ticket/airline app to see whether you check in at T1 or T2 — if your airline has moved (e.g. HK Express/AirAsia), go to T2

Tourist Octopus (HK$39) — the Octopus website lists Hung Fook Tong shops as the main sales point; some sources report that the airport arrivals counter sells it bundled with HK$100 of stored value (HK$139 total) — not yet confirmed on the official site
The Regala shuttle leaves from the Hotel Coach Station (Bay 9–11), which the hotel PDF describes as 'at Terminal 2' (landside, between T1 and T2). If you can't find it, ask at counter B15
hkg-airport.verifyNote: T2 status confirmed by multiple news sources (hongkongairport.com could not be opened — 403). Coordinates = centroid of the T1 building from OSM; the Airport Station (Airport Express) is at 22.31592, 113.93648

regala-skycity.intro: A hotel in the SKYCITY area, next to AsiaWorld-Expo and 11 SKIES, with a covered walkway to Terminal 2. Guests get free shuttles to the airport, Tung Chung Station and Disneyland — it is the base for every day of this trip.
regala-skycity.address: 8 Airport Expo Boulevard, Hong Kong International Airport, Chek Lap Kok (in SKYCITY, next to AsiaWorld-Expo and 11 SKIES). Tel +852 3556 3288

facts.label: Price

facts.value: Exit the park gates and walk toward the Coach Park (the map in the Regala PDF shows Coach Park Row 2, Bay 200–400)

highlights: Shuttle Route 3 (hotel → HZMB → Hong Kong Disneyland, drop-off only): departs 09:15, arrives Disneyland 09:45 / departs 10:15, arrives 10:45

Special return route from Disneyland (valid until 31 Dec 2026): departs from Coach Park – Good Neighbour Hotel Shuttle Station Row 2 50 minutes after 'Momentous: Party in the Night Sky' starts (if there is no show, 20 minutes after park closing) → Regal Airport Hotel (~20 min) → Regala Skycity (~5 min)

One large bag per person (max 76×51×32 cm, 20 kg)
Arrive early — seats are limited and there is no backup bus

skycity-t2.intro: A new district next to the airport with the 11 SKIES mall, restaurants and convenience stores within walking distance of the hotel — good for dinner on the first night without paying hotel restaurant prices.

octopus-card.intro: A single stored-value card for buses, the MTR, the Star Ferry and convenience stores. Get one before leaving the airport on day 1, because you'll need it for the bus on the morning of day 2.

facts.label: Tourist Octopus
facts.value: HK$39 (adult), no stored value, no deposit, card fee not refundable (remaining balance can be refunded but the card is then deactivated); China T-Union version HK$42; sales point per the official site: Hung Fook Tong shops — some sources say the airport sells it at HK$39 + HK$100 stored value = HK$139

facts.label: On-Loan Octopus
facts.value: HK$50 deposit + HK$150 initial value (per the official 'Choice of Octopus' page); sold at the MTR Customer Service Centre in every station, including Airport Station; return it at any CSC (~HK$11 fee if returned within 90 days — unofficial source)

hong-kong-disneyland.intro: The highlight of the trip — a full day from park opening to the night show. Late November falls during the Christmas season, so the park is fully decorated.
hong-kong-disneyland.address: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort, Lantau Island

facts.label: Hours
facts.value: 26 Nov 2026 (Thu): hours for this date not yet checked — the official site shows 10:30–20:00 for Thursday 15 Oct 2026 (typical weekday hours). Check the Park Calendar before you go

facts.label: Price
facts.value: 1-day tickets in 4 tiers (adult / child 3–11 & senior 60+): Tier 1 HK$669 / $499; Tier 2 HK$759 / $569; Tier 3 HK$849 / $639; Tier 4 HK$939 / $705 (prices since 25 Sep 2024, still in use in 2026 — the 2026 Non-stop 2-Day Fun Ticket page cites Tier 1 = HK$669). Late-November weekdays are usually Tier 1–2, but check the pricing calendar

facts.label: Getting there

facts.label: Time needed
facts.value: Full day (opening to closing)

highlights: Christmas event 'A Disney Christmas', 20 Nov 2026 – 3 Jan 2027: Christmas-decorated World of Frozen + artificial snow + winter market; a new castle show with Mickey & Minnie (featuring Stitch); 'A Holiday Wish-Come-True' tree-lighting ceremony with Santa Goofy (snow + drones)
'Disney Christmas Live in Concert!' only on 21–22 Nov and 5–6 Dec 2026 — not on 26 Nov

Nighttime spectacular: 'Momentous' (full name in the Regala document: 'Momentous: Party in the Night Sky') at the Castle of Magical Dreams — usually starts around park closing (~20:00); check the app for the actual time

Daytime parade: 'Disney Friendtastic! Parade' (launched in 2025 for the 20th anniversary) along Main Street, U.S.A. — blogs say it starts around 15:30 and runs ~35 minutes (not yet confirmed for 2026)
Top attractions: World of Frozen, Mystic Manor, Big Grizzly Mountain Runaway Mine Cars, Iron Man Experience, Ant-Man and The Wasp: Nano Battle!, Toy Story Land
tips: Buy tickets in advance and make sure you have a valid park reservation (dated tickets) — buy on hongkongdisneyland.com or in the app
Non-stop 2-Day Fun Ticket: add HK$100 for a consecutive second day (on sale until 31 Dec 2026)

photobooth-tst.nameLocal: Photo booths & self-photo studios by the TST waterfront
photobooth-tst.intro: SNAPIO at K11 MUSEA fits best. It sits right on Avenue of Stars (2-4 min), so you can shoot and be on the promenade for the 20:00 Symphony of Lights.
